description: Change the caller's saved job-search profile: skills, specializations, seniorities, job languages, location preferences, headline and summary. It changes their account, so say what you are about to change and get their agreement first; call `profile` first. Send only the fields that change: a list you send REPLACES the stored one, so use add_skills to add skills without touching the rest. Skills are matched against freehire's skill dictionary; unknown ones are not saved and come back in not_in_dictionary. The result lists which fields were saved.

add_skills.description: Skills to add to the stored list, e.g. ["nx", "cypress"]. Cannot be combined with skills.

excluded_skills.description: Skills to avoid. Replaces the stored list.

headline.description: The profile headline, one line. An empty string clears it.

job_languages.description: Two-letter codes of the languages vacancies may be written in.

location_preferences.description: Where and how they will work (work_modes, remote, base, relocation). Replaces the whole block: read it from `profile` first.

skills.description: The full list of skills wanted. Replaces the stored list.

specializations.description: Job categories wanted, from the specialization vocabulary (see facets).

summary.description: The profile summary, a short paragraph. An empty string clears it.

name: update_profile
